dashboardCharts.name: 92466ea3-9d42-442f-9dcb-38c49a97c25e
dashboardCharts.description: Hourly connection counts (Australia/Sydney) for the top 20 target ports seen by pfSense

dashboardCharts.name: 3326699a-a1b0-423a-8050-0afc9bc39c69
dashboardCharts.displayName: Top 20 Target Ports in Each Hour
dashboardCharts.description: Top 20 target ports seen by pfSense in each hour (Australia/Sydney). Ties for 20th place are included.

dashboardQueries.name: 4362e35b-967e-49e8-927b-9ec669998898
dashboardQueries.query:
stage top_ports {
  metadata.log_type = "PFSENSE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
  $Target_Port = target.port
  $Target_Port > 0

  match:
    $Target_Port

  outcome:
    $Total = count(metadata.id)

  order:
    $Total desc

  limit:
    20
}

metadata.log_type = "PFSENSE"
metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
$Target_Port = target.port
$Target_Port = $top_ports.Target_Port
$Hour = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

match:
  $Hour, $Target_Port

outcome:
  $Count = count(metadata.id)

order:
  $Hour asc

limit:
  10000

dashboardQueries.name: ab34dfd9-3b6d-4a3d-9dc2-23d1b439d896
dashboardQueries.query:
stage hourly_a {
  metadata.log_type = "PFSENSE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
  $Port_Num = target.port
  $Port_Num > 0
  $Slot = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

  match:
    $Slot, $Port_Num

  outcome:
    $Cnt = count(metadata.id)
}

stage hourly_b {
  metadata.log_type = "PFSENSE"
  metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
  $Port_Num = target.port
  $Port_Num > 0
  $Slot = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00", "Australia/Sydney")

  match:
    $Slot, $Port_Num

  outcome:
    $Cnt = count(metadata.id)
}

stage ranked {
  $Slot = $hourly_a.Slot
  $Slot = $hourly_b.Slot
  $Port_Num = $hourly_a.Port_Num
  $Mine = $hourly_a.Cnt
  $Other = $hourly_b.Cnt

  match:
    $Slot, $Port_Num

  outcome:
    $Connections = max($Mine)
    $Higher = sum(if($Other > $Mine, 1, 0))
}

$Hour = $ranked.Slot
$Target_Port = $ranked.Port_Num
$ranked.Higher < 20

match:
  $Hour, $Target_Port

outcome:
  $Count = max($ranked.Connections)

order:
  $Hour asc

limit:
  10000
